summary: PR #607 fixes a real, live-reproduced bug where the VERI ERP chat chain-selector's 'Product' branch sourced from the unrelated PMS `products`/`projects` tables instead of `erpItems`, surfacing project rows and project-management actions (Status update/Log a task/Flag a risk) under a Product entity. Verified against the actual schema.ts that `erpItems` has the `orgId`/`isActive`/`itemName` fields the new `buildProductNodes()` relies on, confirmed `buildProductNodes()` is only called from `buildCapabilityTree()` with no other consumer of the removed `genericProjectActions()` helper, confirmed `products` becomes fully unused and is correctly dropped from the import while `projects`/`inArray` remain genuinely used elsewhere in the file (construction nodes), and confirmed the new fix mirrors the existing, already-correct `buildEntityNodes()` (Customer/Vendor) pattern exactly, including the shared-leaf-array-reference convention that already existed for `GENERIC_ENTITY_ACTIONS`. The new `GENERIC_PRODUCT_ACTIONS`/`GENERIC_ENTITY_ACTIONS` exports and their regression tests are well-targeted at the part of the bug a DB-free test can pin (leaf action set, no fabricated codeReference/engineKey), consistent with this file's own established no-live-DB-in-.test.ts convention. Supporting changes (ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml claim registration, terminology-guardrail-exemptions.yaml count bump for new dated comments, PROGRESS.md) are additive bookkeeping consistent with repo convention. No auth/schema/migration/payment/security path is touched, no .github/workflows/** changes, and the diff is a clean, isolated, additive bug fix -- correctly tier1.
